note: S17.4 companion (sign-off #1 is a DEFERRAL, not a DROP). After move_line sticks the divider at the right cell's min (move_line_sticks_at_min), the freeing-space-by-folding is deferred to the NEXT settle (the S13 two-pass: the settle pass re-reads the stored arrangement and folds an infeasible node). This companion imports B:: (which the MOVE path never does) and runs B::valve over the post-drag bridge tree — a row of two min-600 windows over a 1000-wide canvas (the exact valve_crowded_fold shape: 1200 required > 1000 span) — and asserts the valve WOULD fold (valve_next_settle_folds:true, a fold fact present). This proves the valve fires next settle, NOT that move_line dropped it. The end-to-end two-pass fold is S13's nested_valve_fixpoint, cross-referenced here, not re-proven.
